title: Time Needed to Inform All Employees
summary: A company with n employees, each having a unique ID from 0 to n-1, has a hierarchical structure where the head of the company is identified by headID.
statement: A company with n employees, each having a unique ID from 0 to n-1, has a hierarchical structure where the head of the company is identified by headID. Each employee has a direct manager, and the manager array indicates these relationships. The head will inform his direct subordinates, who will then inform their subordinates, and so on. Each employee requires a specific time to inform their direct subordinates. The task is to determine the total time needed for all employees to receive the urgent news.
constraints: manager describes one rooted employee hierarchy.
A manager informs all direct reports simultaneously after inform_time minutes.
hints: Build child lists from manager links.
The finish time below a manager is its inform_time plus the maximum child finish time.
Compute this recurrence by DFS from the head.
Children receive news simultaneously, so only the slowest branch determines completion.
editorial: Children receive news simultaneously, so only the slowest branch determines completion.

tests.explanation: The sole employee needs no time to inform anyone.
The head takes one minute to inform all employees directly.
